title: Zero Requiem: The Demon Emperor's Final Address

segments.note: The Emperor's parade begins: prisoners in chains, Knightmares lining the road. Sets the stage for his speech.
Lelouch on his throne atop the float, in full command, as the procession moves on.
Lelouch rises from the throne and speaks his last address from the float. Close-ups build up to Zero's arrival.
Zero charges the float and Lelouch meets him. The speech ends in the sword strike that completes the Zero Requiem.
Lelouch's last words, Nunnally realizing what he did, and the crowd's cry. The emotional end of the speech.
